{
  "phoneNote": "The farm-specific styling feels cohesive, but the large gap below the header and extended signpost illustration make the mobile hero unnecessarily tall.",
  "desktopNote": "The alpine identity is distinctive and well coordinated, but the oversized headline and heavy image overlay overpower the scenic view.",

    "impression": 4,

  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 4,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Shorten the mobile hero by reducing the gap below the header and replacing the tall signpost with a compact trail motif, bringing accommodation and prices closer to the first screen.",
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline slightly and use a localized dark gradient behind the text instead of dimming the entire photograph.",
    "Give the mobile room and preserves photographs the full content width, eliminating the conspicuous unused space beside them."
  ]
}
